title: Caramelized Pear and Hazelnut Celebration Tart with Brown-Butter Custard
yield_text: one 28 cm tart serving ten to twelve people

setup.action: Position a rack in the lower third and preheat the oven without fan assistance
setup.target: oven with rack in lower third
setup.duration: at least twenty minutes after the thermostat first signals readiness
notes: Allow this time so the baking stone and oven walls reach an even temperature.
setup.produces: evenly heated 175 °C oven with rack in lower third

setup.action: Arrange the cooled pastry shell on a rimmed tray beside a heatproof landing area
setup.target: stable work surface protected from hot caramel and splashing custard
setup.produces: cooled pastry shell arranged on a rimmed tray beside a heatproof landing area

ingredients.label: unsalted cultured butter
ingredients.source_text: 180 g unsalted cultured butter, cut into small equal cubes

ingredients.label: ripe but still firm Conference pears
ingredients.source_text: 6 large ripe but still firm Conference pears, peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly sized eighths
ingredients.preparation: peeled, cored, and cut lengthwise into evenly sized eighths

ingredients.label: heavy cream with at least thirty-five percent milk fat
ingredients.source_text: 240 mL heavy cream with at least thirty-five percent milk fat

ingredients.label: large free-range eggs
ingredients.source_text: 4 large free-range eggs at room temperature

ingredients.label: skinned roasted hazelnuts
ingredients.source_text: 175 g skinned roasted hazelnuts with no bitter papery fragments remaining, very finely ground but not processed into nut butter
ingredients.preparation: with no bitter papery fragments remaining; very finely ground but not processed into nut butter

ingredients.label: all-butter sweet pastry shell
ingredients.source_text: one 28 cm shell all-butter sweet pastry shell, blind-baked until deeply golden at the edges, completely cooled in its fluted tart pan
ingredients.preparation: blind-baked until deeply golden at the edges; completely cooled in its fluted tart pan

outputs.label: fragrant brown butter with toasted milk solids

operations.until: the milk solids are a deep hazelnut brown and smell nutty without any black specks

outputs.label: evenly caramelized pear wedges with intact edges

operations.until: each wedge is amber on two broad sides yet remains firm enough to lift intact
no dry pockets remain and a ribbon drawn across the surface disappears slowly

outputs.label: unbaked pear and hazelnut tart ready for careful transfer

operations.until: the pear fan remains visible and custard reaches every gap without overflowing the pastry rim

outputs.label: caramelized pear and hazelnut celebration tart with brown-butter custard

operations.until: the outer custard is set while the center retains a small coherent wobble when the tray is nudged
